about: MiniWind test spots: tools/build.py --miniwind-preset NAME (or --miniwind-NAME). Each preset is a MiniWind build with a scope, an optional direct start (--direct-to-game-map), exclusions and an optional --quick-character profile and the quick character screen choice, the console commands run once on arrival (boot_commands: dbg commands only) (skip_census: true, false or null for the default: on unless the row or the command gives a character). The description is the startup screen's Scene: line. Add a spot by adding a row; tools/miniwind_presets.py checks every row. docs/chim/build_guide/MINIWIND.md

presets.name: opening-ship
presets.description: Opening ship: lantern and ship lighting check

presets.description: Animation kit: walk and run with a companion and hostiles
